        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.

        can depend on this small leaf module instead of the full engine — that in turn lets
        components/api/api-modules-java publish the org.eclipse.dirigible.sdk.* annotations to
        engine-java without forming a cycle through api-bpm.

items.content_text:
io.github.luke-popwell:tracker 0.8.0 发布, Java error reporting client for ForgeOps. A
    from-scratch port of gems/forge_ops_tracker (the Rails client), with Servlet and Spring
    integrations. Zero required runtime dependencies: Servlet/Spring are compile-time only
    (provided scope), same role peerDependencies play in the Node client.

items.title:
io.github.luke-popwell:tracker-kt 0.7.0 发布, Kotlin error reporting client for ForgeOps. A
    from-scratch port of sdks/java (this repo's own JVM client), rewritten idiomatically rather
    than wrapped: see README.md for exactly what that means and why this exists alongside the
    Java client rather than folding into it, the same "distinct enough to earn its own SDK"
    reasoning behind TypeScript existing alongside Node.js elsewhere in this repo.
